application_review: PROGRESS. Previous round rechecked and retained proof hashes preserved.
The copy operation changes only the vertex label by inserting or erasing the selected coordinate, while keeping every evaluation point and the original subgroup law.
The two copied means are identified exactly with the two squared projected-face energies and hence are nonnegative without unit-bound hypotheses.
The one-step Cauchy-Schwarz inequality is now written entirely in terms of actual mixed cube means.

The same-coordinate absorption identity respects function-composition order: the inner function copy determines the retained source face. Distinct-coordinate copies commute by exact finite-set identities.

One definition and six theorems are individually audited. Arbitrary-coordinate measure reindexing and full multidimensional iteration remain to be established; no high-order Bessel or main-target completion is claimed.
